flags.name: sync_log
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-482 sync-log panel (manage page) and its matching /help/ section — a read-out of the client-side log:sync IndexedDB store of recent real server round-trips.

flags.name: debug_log
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-812 on-device debug trace — the panel rendered from public/base.html and the static/js/debug_log.js recorder behind it. Scoped to the GRP_DEBUG group: the flag decides who gets the toggle, and recording stays a per-device choice made in the panel, so holding the flag costs nothing until somebody switches the trace on.

flags.name: what3words
flags.note: Gates the SNOW-840 three word address on a trip's meeting point (both the trip page and the public share page), a saved pin and an observation's owner-only address, and its matching /help/ section. On for everyone in production since 2026-11-01; kept as a kill switch — off falls back to the coordinates and keeps stored addresses. Defaults to superusers so a new environment without a WHAT3WORDS_API_KEY stays dark (docs/feature-flags.md).

flags.name: route_drawing
flags.note: Gates drawing a route on the map (SNOW-1255/1256/1257/1259), the draft preview and save endpoints, the routes panel's Draw on the map CTA, the swisstopo ski-routes overlay shown while drawing (SNOW-1261) and the row menu's Download GPX (SNOW-1260). A rollout gate: superusers while it is a prototype. It sits on the surfaces that MAKE a drawn route and never on the ones that read one, so a drawn route shared with, or planned as a trip for, someone outside the flag still works for them.

flags.name: bulletin_alerts
flags.note: Gates bulletin alerts (SNOW-937): the Alerts group on /account/settings/, its endpoints, the region-pin prompt and the /alerts/<date>/ landing page. A rollout gate, being widened in the admin to everyone (SNOW-1361); the gate itself is removed once it has held at 100% for a week. The send command reads Account.notify_when, not this flag, so an account that opted in keeps its alerts if the flag is narrowed; the flag decides who can turn them on.

flags.name: map_modes
flags.note: Gates the map's Dated / Terrain toggle (SNOW-1394): the toggle in the date row, Terrain mode's suppression of the dated overlays (bulletins and their regions, problem-terrain sync, weather, field reports, the season scrubber) and its matching /help/ section. A rollout gate: superusers first. Off, the map has its date row as before and a stored or linked mode is ignored.

flags.name: map_3d
flags.note: Gates /map/'s 3D view (SNOW-1449; apps/public/map_shared.py map_3d_view_enabled): MapLibre terrain on the swisstopo winter map, tilted by the 3D roundel or opened by ?view=3d. map_3d alone since SNOW-1451, signed-in readers only (anonymous requests short-circuit), plus anyone holding a route share's 3D grant while its sharer is in this flag (SNOW-1469). Superusers while it is tried out; production opens it to every signed-in reader after release. Outside the flag /map/ ignores ?view=3d and opens flat. The old /map/3d/ page is a redirect to it since SNOW-1450.

flags.name: map_beyond_switzerland
flags.note: Gates the swisstopo winter map beyond the Swiss border (SNOW-1460; apps/public/map_shared.py map_beyond_switzerland_enabled): OpenStreetMap vector tiles restyled with the winter style's own layers and clipped to outside the swisstopo extent, our relief from the DEM tiles past swisstopo's detail, and swisstopo's scree pattern on OSM scree, in 2D and 3D. With map_3d too, the 3D gate widens from Switzerland to the Alps. Signed-in readers only (anonymous requests short-circuit). Released on its own schedule, separate from map_3d; superusers while it is tried out. Off, the map is exactly as before.
